prose: Fellow Biofield Tuner, Carla Adams, joins InnerVerse to discuss her new book: Ancestral River: A Spiritual Journey for the Living and the Dead. Join us to learn more about the information our Auras and bodies contain about our biological predecessors, how Biofield Tuning works on our own health and mental state, and what this process can do to help our stuck ancestors transition to the Oneness and assist our journeys instead of hindering us.
